querystring.select: SELECT B.PROD_OFFERING_CODE AS prodCode, B.PROD_OFFERING_NAME AS prodName, C.DESCR as descr, A.START_DT as startDt, A.END_DT as endDt, B.PROD_OFFERING_DESCR as prodDescr, CONCAT(A.PROD_OFFERING_VERSION,'/', CASE WHEN A.PROD_OFFERING_H_ID = B.CURRENT_PROD_OFFERING_H_ID THEN 'Current' WHEN A.PROD_OFFERING_H_ID = B.DRAFT_PROD_OFFERING_H_ID THEN 'Draft' ELSE 'Other' END) AS versionName
querystring.from: FROM dbo.PROD_OFFERING_H A WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.PROD_OFFERING B WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.PROD_OFFERING_ID=B.PROD_OFFERING_ID LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER C WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.PROD_STAT=C.MASTER_CODE
